rows.action: Move the 06:45 Kestrel run to start no earlier than Mon 07:00, or assign another driver.
rows.explanation: Planned start of 06:00 breaches the 7 h major rest and the 12 h work limit in the 24 h window. The earliest compliant start is 07:00. The roster creates the breach, so the scheduler must change it.

rows.action: Do not dispatch Rhys on the 2 Nov run; reassign the trip or roster a 24 h rest first.
rows.explanation: Planned 2 Nov start breaches the 24 h rest in 7 days and the 72 h work limit (77.0 h in 7d). No compliant start time exists. The roster creates the breach, so the scheduler must fix it.

rows.action: Reassign Hugo Hartigan's 2026-11-02 17:15 shift; do not run MV1102-1453 or MV1103-1454 as planned.
rows.explanation: The planned shift starts 17:15 on 2 Nov. It has no continuous stationary rest of 5 h in 24 h and 12.2 h work in 24 h (max 12 h). No compliant start is given. The customer-requested plan change moved MV1103-1454 forward, and the roster did not absorb it.

rows.action: Check Aaron's work-time headroom before the 05:00 start on 3 Nov and move the Greyfield trip if needed.
rows.explanation: Only 35 minutes of headroom remain at the planned 05:00 start on 3 Nov. The roster leaves too little margin for the trip, so the scheduler should fix the plan.

rows.action: Hold MV1102-1236 until the coil load is reduced under the 44.0 t limit and re-weighed.
rows.explanation: Measured gross is 45.25 t, over the 44.0 t limit. Declared payload was 25200 kg against 28750 kg measured. Fleet pattern shows Brackenridge declares light on every load, so the cause sits with the consignor, with the loader checking weights.

rows.action: Get the weighbridge ticket for MV1102-1237 before the 06:45 departure, and confirm the true weight with Brackenridge Steel.
rows.explanation: Trip MV1102-1237 is AMBER: a weighbridge ticket is due before departure. Brackenridge Steel's declared weight has run light on every load over four weeks, so the declaration is the upstream cause and the consignor must fix it.

rows.action: Hold MV1102-1238 until a weighbridge ticket and JSEA for the machinery load are on file.
rows.explanation: Declared 14205 kg machinery load has no weighbridge ticket or JSEA. Missing evidence is a stop. Fleet pattern shows Brackenridge Steel under-declares, but this trip is Kestrel Machinery, so that pattern does not apply here.

rows.action: Hold Ella Ekström off all restraint-dependent trips until restraint competency is renewed and recorded.
rows.explanation: Ella Ekström's restraint competency expired 28 Oct, and nine findings show it across her planned trips. The operator's training records must be updated before she loads or restrains any load. Fix the record before she drives.

rows.action: Book Faisal's load restraint refresher before 12 Nov; confirm the booking is made before the 02 Nov depart.
rows.explanation: Six AMBER findings show the same restraint competency expiring 12 Nov, 8 to 10 days away. Trips can run today. Training management must schedule the refresher before the lapse.

rows.action: Remove failed webbing EQ002 from service and replace it before MV1102-1253 departs.
rows.explanation: EQ002 failed inspection on 2026-10-30 (cut webbing near hook) but is still on the load. The failed gear was not tagged out. Operator and loader control the gear and the load restraint.

rows.action: Hold trip MV1103-1302 until the steel row has 3 chain lashings per row, as the table requires.
rows.explanation: Load restraint finding F0024 is RED: 2 lashings planned, 3 required for a 6800 kg row. The loader packs and restrains, so the loader can remove the cause before departure.

rows.action: Review the four speeding events with Hamish Holloway before he drives; record the follow-up.
rows.explanation: Four events 10+ km/h over, max 16 over, none followed up. Engine rule is RED. The fleet Corio pattern is for D09, D14, D16, D26, D30 only, so it does not apply to this driver and is not used here.

rows.action: Check the Greyfield Building delivery slot at Corio before briefing drivers on the Princes Hwy speed zone.
rows.explanation: One minor 6 km/h over event at Princes Hwy, Corio. Fleet pattern shows 20 of 20 events on Greyfield trips, 12-17 minutes before the booked slot. The pressure comes from the delivery window, so the scheduler and consignor can remove it. Trip can run.

rows.action: Check the Greyfield Building delivery slot timing before departure, and follow up the speed event with the driver.
rows.explanation: One minor event (7 km/h over, 25 seconds) at Princes Hwy, Corio. Fleet pattern shows 20 of 20 events were on Greyfield trips 12-17 minutes before the booked slot, across five drivers. The cause sits with the scheduling and delivery window, not this driver alone.

rows.action: Check the Greyfield Building delivery slot at Corio with the scheduler before the next trip.
rows.explanation: One minor event: 5 km/h over on Princes Hwy, Corio, 36 seconds. Fleet pattern shows 20 of 20 events on Greyfield trips, 12-17 minutes before slot. Pressure comes from the delivery window, so scheduler and consignor can fix it.

rows.action: Check the Greyfield Building delivery slot with the consignor before the 06:15 trip; do not coach Zac alone.
rows.explanation: One minor event (8 km/h over, 19 seconds) at Princes Hwy, Corio. The fleet pattern shows 20 of 20 events by five drivers were on Greyfield trips, 12-17 minutes before slot, so the window drives the pressure. Trip can run.

rows.action: Check the Greyfield Building delivery slots before briefing drivers; the speed issue is a schedule pressure problem.
rows.explanation: One minor speed event (6 km/h over, 18 seconds) at Princes Hwy, Corio. Fleet pattern shows 20 of 20 events on Greyfield trips, 12-17 minutes before the booked slot, across five drivers. The pressure comes from the timing, so the scheduler and consignor can remove it.

rows.action: Verify the posted limit at Western Fwy, Bacchus Marsh, and correct the map layer before treating the event as speeding.
rows.explanation: The 60 km/h limit comes from a low-confidence map layer for a roadworks zone that ended 12 Oct. The event is not confirmed as speeding until the posted limit is checked. Not tied to any planned trip.

rows.action: Book PM21 for service before any trip. Do not dispatch it on these runs.
rows.explanation: PM21 is at 584261 km against a service point of 584461 km. Each planned trip takes it past that point, reaching 585221 km by the third trip. Service planning must clear this before use.

rows.action: Confirm PM12 service booking for Wed 04 Nov before its trip on that day.
rows.explanation: PM12 service is due Wed 04 Nov at 265,076 km against a due point of 285,906 km. Nine AMBER service-soon findings cover the trips. Service timing is an operator workshop planning issue, not a driver fault.

rows.action: Hold TR15 until DEF-12409 brake air leak is repaired and cleared. Do not run any trip on TR15 today.
rows.explanation: Open major defect DEF-12409 (air leak at trailer brake chamber, axle 2 nearside), reported 2026-10-31 16:20, is still open on TR15. Every trip on TR15 is affected. The defect was not cleared before use.

rows.action: Move workshop booking WS-12410 or move PM13 dispatch so the truck is not out while booked in.
rows.explanation: PM13 is booked into the workshop Tue 09:00 to 13:00 while its 06:00 departure is planned. The clash is between the workshop booking and dispatch, so the booking needs changing. The trip can still run after a change.

rows.action: Confirm who drove PM20 on Sat 31 Oct 14:10-16:40 and correct the work diary before relying on it.
rows.explanation: PM20 moved for 96 km with no matching work diary entry. The engine cannot infer the driver from the vehicle, so the driver must confirm who drove. Operator must fix the record.

rows.action: Restore telematics feed from unit TU25 on PM25 and confirm speed and trip data is flowing.
rows.explanation: PM25 has sent no telematics for 42 h, so speed and trip checks are incomplete. This is a feed fault, not a driver act. The data owner can restore the feed.
